text:
Dana M: Heads-up — BancoSul POC asks for data residency: all BR customer traffic must be served in sa-east1 and BYOK keys must live in BR KMS. They allow a DR/failover to Canada (northamerica-northeast1) but only for outages. They attached SQ#9921 asking: where will logs/audit trails live, and who are the subprocessors touching BR data?

Ravi T: good context. Are they targeting Hosted API or Dedicated? Also need expected QPS/token volume for sizing.

Dana M: Dedicated preferred for the POC. Estimate ~12 req/s peak, ~40k tokens/day. POC = 2 months. Legal wants explicit wording around where logs/Audit Events are stored.

Clara V: short answers:
- Tenant-pin to a single region is available on Dedicated (we pin routing + storage + model hosting).
- BYOK required: customer must provision a BR-region KMS key (HSM-backed recommended). We store model cache + KV in-region when pinned.
- Subprocessors: we can provide a per-region subproc list (cloud provider + networking partners + selected CDN/monitoring vendors).

Clara V: suggestion for routing policy (YAML example):
```yaml
routing_policy:
  mode: strict_pin   # strict_pin | prefer_with_failover
  primary_region: sa-east1
  failover_regions:
    - northamerica-northeast1  # only used on outage
  kms:
    byok: true
    key_region: sa-east1
  logs_retention: in_region  # in_region | central
```

Clara V: pros/cons: strict_pin => guarantees residency but needs reserved capacity (higher cost, slower autoscale). prefer_with_failover => cheaper, but cross-region egress risk and potential legal pushback.

infra-oncall: quick health endpoints to validate region availability:
```bash
curl -s -I https://inference.sa-east1.redwood.ai/health | head -n 1
curl -s -I https://inference.northamerica-northeast1.redwood.ai/health | head -n 1
```
infra-oncall: to test failover behavior in staging you can apply a routing override (POST to staging router):
```bash
curl -X POST https://staging-router.redwood.ai/overrides -H 'Authorization: Bearer $STAGE_TOKEN' -d '{"force_failover": "northamerica-northeast1"}'
```

Dana M: SQ#9921 specifically asks if any logs (request, audit, metrics) leave the pinned region. Quick answer for now?

Clara V: we retain request logs and audit trails in-region when strict_pin is enabled. Some aggregated metrics and telemetry (anonymized) may be replicated to central analytics for platform health — we can opt-out for a contract clause for regulated customers.

legal-bot: BYOK addendum notes: we need a clause for key custody (customer retains control), ER: key rotation & revocation procedures, key-zeroization on contract end, and explicit acceptance that cross-region failover may cause egress charges outside our standard product fees. I can draft a 1-paragraph addendum.

Ravi T: pricing ask from deal team: 1) POC price for 2 months (dedicated minimal commit), 2) delta between strict_pin vs prefer_with_failover, 3) conservative egress buffer if failover happens once per month. Can someone produce a one-pager?

Clara V: I got this. Will produce: baseline reserved compute, storage, BYOK onboarding fee, and a line for expected cloud inter-region egress. Example calc I'll include: egress_estimate = avg_response_bytes * expected_failover_requests * cloud_egress_rate.

Clara V: sample back-of-envelope: avg_response_bytes=50KB, expected_failover_requests=1,000/month -> monthly_egress_bytes=50MB -> at $0.09/GB => ~ $0.0045/month (rounded up in quote). We'll put a conservative multiplier x10 in the POC quote to be safe.

Dana M: perfect. Also need a short subproc excerpt (BR + CA) for SQ#9921. Who can grab the region-filtered list?

infra-oncall: I'll export region subproc list (cloud provider datacenters, monitoring, CDN, log retention partners) and scrub any internal-only data. Will drop link to the CSV in the next message.

legal-bot: action items: I will draft BYOK addendum paragraph + a residency clause (no logs leave primary region unless contractually permitted). Clara to attach to pricing one-pager.

Clara V: timeline: I can have the pricing one-pager + strict vs soft delta + example egress numbers by EOD tomorrow. Dana, can you collect any customer-specific retention periods from SQ?

Dana M: will ping the customer for retention targets and upload SQ responses to the presales tracker. Scheduling: propose quick call Fri 09:00 BRT to walk them through the two model options and BYOK steps.

Ravi T: thumbs up. Who will own the POC runbook (routing test steps + KMS onboarding checklist)?

Clara V: I'll own the runbook with infra-oncall - will include curl checks, staging failover test, and BYOK onboarding checklist.

Dana M: thanks team. Marking owners: Clara -> quote + runbook, infra-oncall -> region subproc CSV + staging tests, legal-bot -> BYOK addendum. I'll send calendar invite after Clara posts the one-pager. :rocket:
